why: Megabuilding H10 in Little China is V's home megablock: a ground-floor lobby and market, floor 07 services (2nd Amendment gun shop and shooting range, Coach Fred's gym and fighting ring, Barry Lewis' flat) and floor 08 apartments including V's. The mod already keeps V's apartment (mq000), the district vendor wiring (little_china_vendors) and the ambient vendor dialog layer (default_dialogs), so Wilson, Viktor, Coach Fred and Misty already stand in their shops. What is missing is the building's population: the lobby residents, the vending-machine and phone-call regulars, the two kids on the wall, Barry in his flat and a couple of customers in 2nd Amendment.

open_questions: Catalogue gap, blocks the main fix: #megabuilding_com_001 (id 13483497367760522212) is the H10 apartment-floor crowd with ~80 entries (gym, tenants, floor vendors, homeless, stoop kids) but has no resolved community area path, so mine-venues emitted no community_options for it and the checker rejects every entry. Resolving its area node (or letting whole-community activation through for a registered spawner) would let a follow-up restore the real crowd.

Is the shooting-range door #q001_dvc_wilson_range_door sealed in a build without persistent_content? If yes, the range and the contestants' rail spot are unreachable until the runtime door policy unseals it.

Variant semantics are inferred from usage: player_blocker and wilson_door_blocker are treated as '1 = blocker shown'. Both are set to 0 here because those are the only values vanilla uses for the normal/open state.

Loading #q001_pr_megabuilding also loads the fistfight tutorial sub-prefab; that sub-prefab's only variant is player_blocker (already 0), it adds no meshes and activates no one (its gym_robo_fighter entry starts inactive), and the prefab has to stay because the lobby regulars' spawners live inside it. Confirm Coach Fred's ring and the range are walkable and nothing tutorial-like is visible.

Consider whether wat_lch_phase should simply be kept instead of per-venue crowds: it activates #megabuilding_com_001 whole plus the floor-01 market community, which is the cheapest way to repopulate every megabuilding interior at once.

communities.why: Owner tour 2026-11-26: the two residents stood at the broken-gate panel on V's own floor, staring through the gate, which is open in the clean slate. The gate-closed spots are {q001_ws_broken_gate}1 (routine__stand_ground_device__fix on the panel) and {q001_ws_broken_gate}2; after_chat1 is vanilla's after-the-gate phase and the entry's own initial phase, and its {q001_ws_broken_gate1_aft} spot at (-1393.61, 1261.31, 123.08) is a relaxed cigarette by the corridor. The tour that flagged this ran at 17:47, before the phase change landed (fa60430, 18:04), so it saw gate_closed; this is a re-test, not a new fix.

Owner tour 2026-11-26: same gate_panel problem as resident1; after_chat1 is the entry's own initial phase, and its {q001_ws_broken_gate2_aft} spot at (-1394.26, 1277.09, 123.08) is the corridor vending machine (generic__stand_vending_machine__use__01), a relaxed use pose. The tour that flagged this ran at 17:47, before the phase change landed (fa60430, 18:04).
Regular leaning on the floor-01 vending machine; vanilla q001 uses this exact relaxed phase (generic__stand_vending_machine_lean_front__hit__01).
Market vendor on a phone call in the floor-01 stalls; vanilla q001 activates exactly this phase (generic__stand_ground__phone_talk__01).
Stoop kid leaning on the wall, the phase's normal stance; the mq010_* phases are the Barry aftermath and are deliberately not used.
Second stoop kid leaning on the same wall with a cigarette; relaxed ambient stance.

A customer leaning on the shooting-range rail in Wilson's open shop: the entry's own spot map gives contestant_01/idle {mq011_ws_contestant_idle_}000 at (-1439.20, 1304.72, 119.06), generic__stand_rail_lean_front__stand_around__01, while default is the contest line-up (stand_ground_shotgun__stand_around) and shooting is an aim pose. The tour that marked this a problem could not get into the range, whose door was still sealed then; fa60430's seal rule should have unsealed it, so this is a re-test.

Second customer checking a phone in the shop: contestant_03/idle maps to {mq011_ws_contestant_idle_}_002 at (-1441.26, 1342.09, 119.06), generic__stand_ground_cellphone__check_phone__01, vanilla's own mq011 idle spot on the 2nd Amendment floor. Same re-test as contestant_01: the range door was sealed at tour time.

variant_toggles.why: Hides the tutorial's invisible player blocker so Coach Fred's ring and gym stay walkable in the open world; the tutorial shows it (1) for the bout and hides it (0) afterwards, so 0 is the normal look. player_blocker is the tutorial prefab's only variant, and the sub-prefab itself adds no meshes and activates no one: its contents are four trigger areas, the crowd-null area, two workspots and the blocker collision, and its gym_robo_fighter community starts inactive and is only reactivated by the unkept q001_fistfight_tutorial phase.
Clears the shop's invisible door blocker so 2nd Amendment is enterable; the only state vanilla ever sets is 0, from the mq011 bugfix phase that the clean slate omits.

proximity_wait.why: The broken metal-fence gate (#q001_door_mb_v_floor, gate_metal_fence_prefab5OZIO4Q) on V's own floor, where the two residents stood at tour time: a DoorControllerPS vanilla drives (q001_ride_to_mb) and that every player passes between the lift and the apartment, at z ≈ 123. Its proximity covers the floor-07 flat and shop (z ≈ 119) and the floor-08 corridor; the lobby at street level gets the boot activation only.
